title: Spiritual Warfare Prayers
author: Unknown
description: Spiritual Warfare Prayers: Daily Armor for Today's Real Life Battles, a contemporary Christian devotional of 101 prayers 'to reclaim peace, crush darkness, strengthen your spirit, and walk boldly in God's authority'. Its preface opens with the claim that life is a battlefield and frames the believer's struggles in terms of Ephesians 6 and the armour of God. The prayers address anxiety and fear, temptation, family and relationships, health, finances, work, protection from evil and breaking spiritual strongholds, each grounded in scripture and written for daily use, and it ends with a conclusion titled 'The battle belongs to the Lord'. No author is named in the file. It represents modern evangelical and charismatic spiritual-warfare devotion.
